title: Senior PHP Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Crewfare is a travel tech company transforming how groups travel and experience the world. We leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional service to deliver unforgettable journeys. Our culture is collaborative, creative, and focused on delivering exceptional results.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced PHP Developer  to join our growing engineering team on a 6-month contract, with the potential to extend to 12 months. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing our backend systems and integrations that power Crewfare’s travel management platform. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and efficient solutions that enhance the user experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using PHP.
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver high-quality features.
  • Optimize database queries and backend performance for scalability and reliability.
  • Integrate with third-party APIs and internal systems.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Working hours overlapping with US Eastern Time.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in PHP development.
  • Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and secure coding practices.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with JavaScript, jQuery, React, or WordPress.
  • Familiarity with AWS services  such as EC2 and RDS.
  • Knowledge of frontend best practices and UI integration.
  • Exposure to CI/CD workflows and version control (Git).


Contract Details

  • Duration:  6-month contract, with potential extension to 12 months
  • Compensation:  Paid monthly
  • Location:  Remote, international applicants welcome


Why Join Us?

  • Work with a passionate, fast-moving team building real-world travel technology.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a growing company.
  • Collaborative and supportive remote culture.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization.   • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools

Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .

  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.

  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. Vem transformar com a gente!

Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

· Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.

· Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.

· Conhecimento da LGPD e princípios éticos para uso de IA.

Local: Remoto

description:

This role blends creative storytelling with performance marketing expertise , you’ll write, test, and optimize ad copy that drives engagement and lead generation.

You’ll collaborate closely with the team to develop data-driven ad messaging that scales across platforms. If you love combining words, metrics, and AI tools to create ads that convert — this role is for you.

  • Write and test compelling copy for paid ads across Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube .

    • Increased ad engagement and click-through rates (CTR).

    • Proven track record in direct response, lead generation, or performance marketing .

    • Basic understanding of media buying and campaign structure.

    • Competitive compensation

description:

Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

How to Stand Out

Stack


ChatGPT • Claude • Descript • OpusClip • Canva • Lumen5 • CapCut • Publer • HubSpot / HighLevel • Notion • Zapier / Make

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Senior Accountant

We’ve partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

title: Analista de QA Pleno – Automação com Playwright
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Analista de QA Pleno com experiência em automação de testes, utilizando Playwright . Se você é detalhista, gosta de garantir a qualidade em cada entrega e quer evoluir junto com um time apaixonado por tecnologia, essa vaga é para você!


O que você irá fazer:

  • Implementar procedimentos de controle de qualidade.
  • Planejar cenários de testes com base nos requisitos do produto, em parceria com o time e o Product Owner.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de qualidade da área e dos times.
  • Coletar e analisar dados para avaliar o desempenho do produto em relação aos padrões de qualidade.
  • Garantir a eficiência e o funcionamento das aplicações.
  • Promover e disseminar boas práticas de qualidade entre os profissionais da equipe.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharias, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • De 4 a 5 anos de experiência na área de QA, com foco em automação de testes.
  • Experiência com planejamento, preparação e execução de testes conforme as funcionalidades desenvolvidas.
  • Vivência com uso de simuladores/mocks.
  • Conhecimento em lógica e linguagem de programação (preferencialmente Java).
  • Experiência com automatização de testes utilizando Playwright, JUnit e/ou Rest Assured.
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência em automação de testes (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, JavaScript).
  • Suporte a desenvolvedores na criação de testes unitários e de componente.
  • Conhecimento em testes não funcionais (stress e capacity).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de controle de qualidade para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:


We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive SOC Analyst – Level 2 with a focus on Operational Technology (OT) environments. This role involves handling escalated incidents, collaborating with platform teams, and enhancing threat detection logic across OT systems. The analyst will play a key role in supporting incident response and improving alert fidelity, particularly within platforms such as Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel.


What You’ll Do:

  • Provide incident handling and escalation support for critical alerts, especially from the Nozomi platform.
  • Advise on security issue isolation and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Lead incident response and threat containment activities in OT environments.
  • Collaborate with the Nozomi platform team to fine-tune rules and reduce alert noise in Sentinel.
  • Create and maintain playbooks for automating incident response related to Nozomi alerts.
  • Enhance threat detection logic and perform false positive tuning to improve alert quality.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in SOC operations, particularly in OT environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel platforms.
  • Familiarity with incident response workflows, playbook creation, and alert tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment and collaborate across teams.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.
  • English Advanced (B2/C1)
  • Certified in Microsoft (IT) and Nozomi (OT) (MANDATORY)


UST is waiting for you!

title: Paid Media Campaign Manager (Brazil)
description:
Paid Media Campaign Manager (Remote)

Location: Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week, PST hours (flexible contract)

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate in USD, based on experience



About Adquadrant


Adquadrant is the AI-powered growth partner for modern consumer brands.


We help high-growth companies scale intelligently by transforming data, creative, and media into a connected intelligence system that learns and optimizes every day. Our approach unites four core pillars: Brand Intelligence, Media, Creative, and Measurement, all orchestrated through an AI framework that continuously adapts to performance signals and market shifts. At the center is Prism, Adquadrant’s AI intelligence engine that unifies data from every channel, identifies growth patterns, and powers real-time decision-making with precision and clarity. Through this connected model, we have helped next-generation brands generate over a billion dollars in attributable revenue and build lasting momentum in a constantly evolving market. The next era of growth is intelligent. Adquadrant builds the system behind it.


About the Role


We are seeking a Paid Media Campaign Manager who is comfortable managing cross-channel (Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, etc) paid media campaigns for US-based e-commerce and lead generation brands and is fanatical about AI usage to empower better and faster outcomes for clients.. You will handle day-to-day media execution across platforms, dive deep into performance data, and bring a test-and-learn mindset to every campaign.

This role is ideal for someone who is both a strategist and an operator, who thrives on solving complex performance challenges, enjoys building from 0 to 1, and knows how to connect data insights to creative opportunities.


Key Responsibilities


Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Pmax, Shopping, Display, YouTube), Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Ads.
  • Manage and scale client budgets across multiple accounts, driving consistent ROAS and KPI achievement.
  • Analyze campaign data daily and adjust targeting, bidding, and creative to maximize performance.
  • Prepare performance reports using GA4, Looker Studio, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, and other attribution platforms.


Strategy & Innovation

  • Build and test strategies across new and emerging channels (e.g., Demand Gen, CTV, Retail Media).
  • Collaborate with creative and analytics teams to develop performance-driven media briefs.
  • Forecast and model potential performance outcomes using MMM, MTA, and cross-channel attribution data.


Client Collaboration

  • Partner closely with US-based teams and clients to align on objectives, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Present insights, strategic recommendations, and clear next steps in a client-facing capacity.
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and communicate performance learnings.


Qualifications


  • 5+ years managing multi-channel paid media campaigns across both Paid Search and Paid Social.
  • Proven success optimizing toward ROAS, CPA, CPL, and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing large-scale budgets ($100K+/month) across multiple brands in the english speaking markets (US strongly preferred).
  • Proficiency with GA4, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, or equivalent tools.
  • Understanding of forecasting, cross-channel attribution (MMM or MTA), and incrementality testing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly and professionally with US-based clients.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple accounts independently.
  • Hands-on experience writing creative briefs and collaborating with creative teams.
  • Google Ads and Meta certifications preferred; TikTok, Pinterest, or LinkedIn certifications are a plus.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • Managed $500K+ in monthly ad spend across a diverse portfolio of eCommerce clients.
  • Experience launching new channels or products from 0–1 with measurable success.
  • Skilled in reporting, visualization, and data storytelling through GA4 and Supermetrics.
  • Excels in environments that value data-driven decisions, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to continuously test and learn.
  • Passionate about media innovation, AI-driven performance insights, and delivering measurable impact.

title: Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension)
description:
We are looking for a remote Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension) to develop and publish Chrome extensions for our U.S. client. The duration of this project will last 3-6 months with the opportunity to extend into a full-time position.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively implement formal security and privacy programs, measure the effectiveness of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality
  • Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to ensure smooth data flow and consistent UI/UX
  • Debug, test, and optimize extensions for performance, compatibility, and scalability
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Chrome extensions, including publishing, version control, and updates in the Chrome Web Store
  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
Buscamos um(a) Senior AI Product Manager para liderar a evolução dos Agentes de IA Sankhya — um portfólio de soluções inteligentes recursos de Inteligência Artificial que ajuda nossos clientes a vender mais, com mais margem e menos atrito.

Você será responsável por transformar modelos e algoritmos em experiências reais dentro do ERP, conectando IA, UX e negócio em soluções que impactam diretamente o faturamento dos clientes Sankhya.



Sua missão na equipe

Conduzir a estratégia, priorização e entrega de produtos de IA e automação voltados à área comercial dos nossos clientes, garantindo que cada agente entregue valor mensurável e rápido ao usuário final.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de produto de IA, desde discovery até rollout, garantindo impacto direto nos KPIs de venda e margem dos clientes.
  • Traduzir oportunidades de negócio em hipóteses testáveis, definindo o que deve ser resolvido com IA e o que pode ser entregue via regras e lógica.
  • Priorizar backlog e roadmap de Sales Agents com base em métricas de adoção, ROI e potencial de receita incremental.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com engenheiros de IA, cientistas de dados e designers para transformar modelos em experiências fluídas in-line no ERP Sankhya.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre tecnologia, produto e estratégia comercial, influenciando stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Criar dashboards de performance e feedback loops para medir impacto e gerar aprendizado contínuo sobre o uso dos agentes.
  • Atuar como referência em estratégias de AI productization, ajudando a evoluir a maturidade da companhia na criação de produtos com IA embarcada.



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager em produtos digitais com forte componente de dados, IA ou automação;
  • Capacidade comprovada de converter modelos em experiências de produto (Generative AI, Recomendação, Predição, etc.);
  • Habilidade analítica com ferramentas como SQL, Python ou ambientes de experimentação (A/B testing, feature flags, etc.);
  • Vivência em produtos com ciclo de melhoria contínua baseado em métricas de impacto e uso real;
  • Excelente comunicação para conectar times técnicos, designers e executivos, traduzindo o “porquê” de cada decisão;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas SaaS e produtos ERP ou B2B é um diferencial relevante.



O que seria muito legal se você tivesse

  • Ter liderado produtos ou features baseadas em IA generativa ou preditiva aplicadas a contexto de negócio real (ex: pricing, recomendação, forecasting);
  • Conhecimento em monetização de IA, métricas de ROI e PLG orientado a dados;
  • Vivência com LLMs e frameworks de orquestração (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, etc.);
  • Experiência em conectar múltiplos fluxos de dados (ERP, CRM, vendas) para gerar inteligência de negócio;
  • Background técnico suficiente para discutir pipelines, inferência e integrações em tempo real com engenheiros.



O que te tornaria um especialista para essa vaga

  • Ter liderado produtos de IA que impactaram diretamente receita;
  • Saber equilibrar experimentos de IA com entregas de alto valor sem depender sempre de modelos complexos;
  • Ter visão de negócio e produto acima de apenas dados — enxergando o todo da jornada do cliente;
  • Saber contar histórias com dados (data storytelling) e influenciar decisões estratégicas.


Se você deseja liderar a fronteira da inovação em IA e contribuir para um ERP que aprende e evolui com seus usuários, seu lugar é aqui!

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Coordenação de Eficiência Energética
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Definir política, metas, baseline e governança de eficiência energética, alinhado à ISO 50001.
  • Gerir portfólio de projetos de eficiência, incluindo bombeamento, VFDs, reengenharia hidráulica e qualidade de energia.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs energéticos e financeiros (kWh/m³, R$/m³, demanda contratada vs. medida, FP, custo evitado).
  • Implantar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP), garantindo savings auditáveis com ajustes de baseline e sazonalidade.
  • Priorizar CAPEX/OPEX com business cases (TIR, VPL, payback) e conduzir TRs, RFPs e contratos de performance.
  • Integrar dados de medição e padronizar cadastros e repositórios energéticos.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e engajar áreas multifuncionais, reportando resultados a fóruns executivos e auditorias.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em eficiência energética ou gestão de energia.
  • Vivência prática em liderança de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Domínio técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores, acionamentos (VFDs), fator de potência e qualidade de energia.
  • Conhecimento em tarifação, contratos de energia e medições com analisadores.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Medição e Verificação (IPMVP).
  • Excel avançado.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações: CEM, CMVP, ISO 50001, PMP ou metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e/ou SQL.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. title: DTC Ecommerce Conversion Rate Optimization Funnel Expert
description:
Marketing Agency | Apex Brands Based in San Diego - CA


We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.


Our Mission: to help D2C e-commerce companies grow holistically


Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


*MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH*


*MUST BE ABLE TO WORK US HOURS (9 AM - 5 PM PST)*


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an experienced Ecommerce Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist with a strong background in building funnels for DTC ecommerce brands. We need someone who can work in a growing company and fast-paced environment. Must be able to deliver solid results and have a great work ethic/communication skills or you probably will not be a good fit.


The ideal candidate will have a strong background in DTC ecommerce conversion rate optimization along with creative skills and a portfolio of work that demonstrates their passion for CRO, funnel design, research specifically in the ecommerce industry.


We are looking for someone who is an all-star team player and wants to be the best at anything they do. We need someone who has a lot of experience who can lead a team of UX/UI designers to build funnels for our clients that we can use in our Meta and Google ads campaigns to increase conversion rates.


Responsibilities

  • Researching and analyzing heatmaps and data to hypothesize on funnels that we can create to increase conversion rates from our ads
  • Work with our UX/UI design team to create landing page funnels for e-commerce products and offers
  • Creating A/B split-test ideas to improve conversion rates
  • Communicate with clients to effectively handle their revisions and concerns on the works that you create
  • Communicate with the website development team to ensure your funnel designs are developed effectively and exactly to your specifications. Must also know how to perform quality checks.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure consistency of designs across various media outlets
  • Research direct and indirect competitors of our clients to create UX/UI designs of optimized versions of their websites
  • Create beautiful and effective funnel designs for e-commerce websites that consist of various CRO aspects
  • Maintain awareness of the current e-commerce industry trends, technology trends, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in conversion rate optimization or related field OR 2-3 years of experience in conversion rate optimization SPECIFICALLY FOR E-COMMERCE
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills, and design skills
  • Must have a strong understanding of AI and how to use it within the workplace to make your job easier
  • Autonomous worker with a creative mind
  • Portfolio of work


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $6000 USD per month

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil
  • ensures compliance with national regulatory requirements (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) and supports the company’s product launch plans in alignment with global and regional regulatory strategies.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute registration strategies for Brazil in line with business priorities and product portfolio
  • Prepare, compile, and submit registration dossiers for technical and formulated products in compliance with local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external consultants, laboratories, manufacturers, and internal technical teams to ensure high-quality and complete submissions.
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) through local partners or directly when required.
  • Monitor progress of submissions, follow up on authority requests, and manage timelines to ensure efficient approval.
  • Track and analyze updates in Brazilian and LATAM regulatory frameworks, assessing potential business impacts and advising management accordingly.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and documentation archives to ensure full traceability and compliance.
  • Provide regulatory support to commercial, marketing, and R&D teams regarding registration timelines, status, and compliance requirements.
  • Support post-registration activities, such as renewals, label updates, and re-registration processes.
  • Collaborate with global regulatory teams to align strategies and share best practices.



Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Graduate in Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or related fields.
  • 4 years of working experience in regulatory affairs or product registration within the agrochemical / crop protection industry.
  • In-depth understanding of Brazil’s registration procedures and authorities: MAPA/IBMA/ANVISA and state authorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple registration projects with strict timelines
  • Strong coordination and communication skills with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in English (written & spoken) and Portuguese (mandatory for Brazil-based communication).
  • Detail-oriented and capable of interpreting technical and scientific data.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience in a multinational agrochemical company or regulatory consulting firm


Soft skill:

  • Demonstrates a proactive, self-driven approach with a high sense of accountability.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment

title: ITSM Consultant / Specialist
description:
O Consultor ITSM será responsável por desenhar, implementar e otimizar processos de Gerenciamento de Serviços de TI alinhados às melhores práticas do ITIL. Este papel apoia iniciativas de transformação em clientes como Petrobras e Banco Bradesco, garantindo uma entrega de serviços escalável, automatizada e em conformidade com os padrões corporativos.


Responsabilidades Principais

• Projetar e implementar processos de ITSM: Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças, Solicitações e Configuração.

• Liderar implantações e melhorias da plataforma ServiceNow, incluindo Itens de Catálogo, Flow Designer e integrações de CMDB.

• Conduzir workshop e sessões de ideação para definir fluxos de trabalho para atendimento e garantia.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para alinhar os serviços de TI com os objetivos de negócios.

• Monitorar o desempenho do serviço e impulsionar iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar esforços de automação para reduzir o volume de incidentes e melhorar os tempos de resolução.


Habilidades Requeridas

• Sólida experiência em ServiceNow (certificação CSA desejável), incluindo script, integração e design de catálogos.

• Proficiência em framework ITIL e ferramentas ITSM (por exemplo, BMC, OpenText).

• Experiência com CMDB, ATF e análises de plataforma.

• Familiaridade com Java, Spring Boot, SQL e APIs RESTful.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.


Certificações

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• ITIL v4 Foundation ou superior

• Opcionais: PMP, Agile/Scrum


Experiência Preferencial

• Mais de 5 anos em consultoria ou funções de entrega em ITSM.

• Experiência nos setores de telecomunicações, bancário ou de energia.

• Envolvimento anterior em programas de transformação em larga escala (por exemplo, realocação da Petrobras, sourcing do Bradesco).


Habilidades Comportamentais

• Mentalidade analítica com capacidades de resolução de problemas.

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.

• Colaborativo e proativo em interações entre equipes.

Indicadores de Desempenho

• Redução no volume de incidentes através da automação (meta: 20–30%).

• Cumprimento de SLA e índices de satisfação do cliente.

• Implantação bem-sucedida dos módulos de ITSM dentro dos prazos acordados.

title: Data Scientist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

- 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

Benefits:

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Sharepoint Team Lead
description:
Sharepoint Team Lead

**Add resumes in English**


- Responsibilities

SharePoint Development & Customization

  • Develop and customize SharePoint solutions using SPFx for modern web parts and extensions.
  • Build low-code applications and automate workflows using Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Create custom solutions using REST API & CSOM.
  • Implement and maintain front-end solutions using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and SPFx web parts.

SharePoint Administration & Configuration

  • Customize Modern and Classic SharePoint user interfaces.

Database & Backend Development

  • Manage Azure SQL and Microsoft Dataverse for cloud-based storage.

Cloud & Integration Technologies

  • Develop automation and backend services using Azure Functions.
  • Manage identity and access through Active Directory and Azure AD.
  • Integrate SharePoint with Microsoft Teams and OneDrive.
  • Perform content migration using third-party tools (e.g., ShareGate, AvePoint).
  • Implement and support Enterprise Content Management (ECM) governance solutions.


- Experience Requirements / Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Graph API for integrating with Microsoft 365 services.
  • Experience with Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Familiarity with third-party SharePoint migration tools (ShareGate, AvePoint).
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies and hybrid SharePoint environments.
  • Good communication skills in English (Mandatory).
